rows.headline: The Exchange has sought clarification from Quick Heal Technologies Ltd on October 15, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
rows.subject: Clarification sought from Quick Heal Technologies Ltd
rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from Quick Heal Technologies Ltd on October 15, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Quick Heal Technologies Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Quick Heal Technologies Limited has submitted their response.
